title: Birbal and the Greedy Barber
moral: Greed and lies lead to trouble.

scenes.summary: A barber claims he can talk to people in heaven.
scenes.text: One day, a barber came to Emperor Akbar and claimed he could talk to people in heaven.
scenes.image_prompt: barber speaking confidently to king in royal court, cartoon style

scenes.summary: The barber offers to deliver messages to ancestors.
scenes.text: The barber said he could go to heaven and deliver messages, hoping to gain rewards from the king.
scenes.image_prompt: barber making big claims in court while others listen, cartoon

scenes.summary: Birbal plans to test the barber’s claim.
scenes.text: Birbal realized the barber was lying and decided to test him with a clever plan.
scenes.image_prompt: birbal thinking cleverly in court, colorful cartoon

scenes.summary: Birbal prepares a fire to send the barber to heaven.
scenes.text: Birbal ordered a large fire to be prepared and said the barber would be sent to heaven through it.
scenes.image_prompt: large fire being prepared while barber looks shocked, cartoon scene

scenes.summary: The barber admits the truth and is punished.
scenes.text: The barber became scared and admitted he was lying. Akbar punished him. Greed and lies lead to trouble.
scenes.image_prompt: barber apologizing while king and birbal watch, cartoon illustration

story: One day, a barber told Emperor Akbar that he could talk to people in heaven and deliver messages. Akbar asked Birbal for advice. Birbal knew the barber was lying and planned a test. He ordered a fire to send the barber to heaven. The barber became scared and admitted the truth. Akbar punished him for his dishonesty.
